title: Specification

validation.research: Evans and Fowler's original 19-page Specifications paper establishes separation of matching requirements from candidates and selection code, selection/validation/build-to-order uses, and hard-coded, parameterized, and composite variants. Composite Specification is treated as a variant rather than a duplicate canonical pattern. Official Ardalis documentation supplies the IsSatisfiedBy candidate-to-Boolean validation contract. Microsoft documents query specifications with data-shaping capabilities; those are not attributed to the callable-backed example. Python supports short-circuit semantics, non-Boolean operand returns from and/or, and frozen-field limits. PostgreSQL supports the distinct three-valued SQL semantics and evaluation-order caution. The print-job policy, code, and native illustrations are original teaching material.
validation.python_examples: Both actual article blocks execute and produce all five stated lines exactly. Checks verify inclusive page limits, positive integer counts and parameters, strict Boolean candidate flags and predicate results, nonblank IDs, candidate and operand type checks, malformed predicate rejection, propagated dependency errors, AND/OR/NOT truth tables, operand preservation, new objects on composition, and left-to-right short-circuit traces. All 120 combinations of three flags, five page counts, and three limits match an independent approval-pair oracle. Proof-copy exceptions cannot bypass either the page limit or cancellation. Selection and validation use the same object; filtering preserves input order and an empty input remains empty. Frozen candidates and wrapper references reject normal field assignment. An explicit mutable closure example demonstrates why a frozen wrapper does not freeze external dependencies. No SQL translation, database, authorization, job release, or I/O is implemented.

Coverage includes canonical ID and aliases without duplicates, one primary home with all prior members retained, eight sections, exact copyable highlighted code, accessible responsive figures and intrinsic dimensions, resolved related links, search, ten queries, revision hashes, and concept marks. The run uses maxWorkers=2, testTimeout=20000, and hookTimeout=60000 to bound corpus-loading concurrency and allow the existing large search corpus.

example_limits: Two-valued in-memory evaluation of complete immutable PrintJob snapshots. The original policy is (approved OR proof_copy) AND pages <= 40 AND NOT cancelled; all counts are positive integers. Specification stores a trusted callable and composes callbacks rather than building an inspectable expression tree. It implements no SQL translator, serialization, query optimizer, explain-all-failures diagnostic, ranking, release operation, authorization mechanism, lock, persistence, or concurrency control. Arbitrary predicates can capture mutable state, perform effects, or fail; the wrapper does not enforce purity or deep-freeze closures. Short-circuiting can skip predicates, errors propagate, and deeply nested expressions can exhaust recursion limits. A query adapter must deliberately align units, null handling, comparisons, and evaluation assumptions with its target system. Passing a snapshot criterion is not durable acceptance of a later state transition.
publication: Local implementation only. No publishing, deployment, push, or pull request.
